forces: mutations.test.mjs must verify that the SDK verification suite does not leak Git configuration mutations into the local repository.
Concurrent branch writes (such as git push -u or branch deletion in sibling worktrees) must not trip the post-suite configuration equality check.
Detection of configuration leaks within the suite blast radius (such as commit.gpgsign) must remain strictly enforced.
Repository workflow documentation must instruct agents and workers to avoid writing upstream branch configuration during concurrent runs.
